_about: isoamyl-alcohol (1) + water (2): the two liquids in equilibrium measured in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive's records (bulk file ThermoML.v2020-09-30.tgz), by validation/python/two_liquid_survey.py --classes (proposal 0019, step 2). Rows: T in K, P in kPa (null where the record gives none), mole fraction of component 1 in liquid I and in liquid II, index of the record in records.
